title: THE HAUL REVEAL STOPS WITH ITS CARD
why: Found in the cloud hunt of 2026-10-15: the EXTRACTED card's button closed the card without ending the haul reveal, and a close the game makes itself (netCardOff when the party lift takes a teammate still reading his card) is a script click the skip never sees, so the reveal kept ticking behind the Undercroft and played the pick sound of every item still hidden. Proven in headless Chromium: {"closed":true,"state":"hub","stillRevealing":true,"soundsAfterClose":8}. The button now ends the reveal as it closes the card. Display only: nothing paid or kept moves.
now: Leaving the EXTRACTED card mid reveal no longer plays pick sounds in the Undercroft.

edits.replacement:
document.getElementById('oc_btn').onclick=function(){
  HAUL_REV=null;   // v16.xx (cloud-menus-haul-reveal-stops), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: a card closed mid reveal (the party lift, netCardOff) ends the reveal, so no pick sound plays in the Undercroft
